payload.name: FANCJ-mediated G4 resolution
payload.fact: FANCJ helicase acts to resolve G-quadruplex (G4) DNA structures to facilitate DNA replication.

provenance.title: An emerging picture of FANCJ's role in G4 resolution to facilitate DNA replication.
provenance.quote_or_locus: FANCJ, a DNA helicase implicated in cancer and the chromosomal instability disorder Fanconi Anemia, takes center stage in G4 resolution to allow smooth DNA replication
